relationships.subject: cilostazol
relationships.evidence_quote: Oral cilostazol ameliorated the symptoms of mechanical allodynia but not thermal analgesia in DM rats.

relationships.subject: cilostazol
relationships.evidence_quote: Cilostazol administration also suppressed microglial hyperactivation and increased astrocyte expressions in spinal dorsal horns.

relationships.subject: cilostazol
relationships.evidence_quote: the number of CGRP-positive nerve endings detected in the cilostazol-treated DM groups appeared comparable to those observed in the control group

relationships.subject: cilostazol
relationships.evidence_quote: Among the cilostazol-treated DM rats, the 30 and 100 mg/kg treatment groups showed relatively preserved numbers of TRPV-1 positive nerve fibers in the paw dermis

key_findings: Diabetic rats lost PGP9.5-, P2X3-, CGRP- and TRPV1-labeled epidermal nerve fibers; cilostazol at 30 and 100 mg/kg preserved them dose-dependently.
Cilostazol reduced spinal microglial activation and mechanical allodynia.
